name: Soratami Cloud Chariot
oracle_text:
{2}: Target creature you control gains flying until end of turn.
{2}: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by target creature you control this turn.
blocked_sentences: {2}: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt to and dealt by target creature you control this turn.

needs.what: a `combat_only` flag on the `prevent_damage_permanent` op (and the PermanentShield it installs), so a resolving activated ability can prevent only COMBAT damage dealt to and by one targeted creature you control this turn, leaving noncombat damage to and from it unprevented
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `prevent_damage_permanent` with `dealt: "to_and_by"` and `duration: "this_turn"` is the exact shape, but its shield stops all damage, so the creature would also be immune to burn and its noncombat damage would be prevented -- a strictly better card. `combat_only` exists only on the `prevent_damage` STATIC, which a resolving ability cannot install, has no 'this turn' duration and only faces 'dealt to'.
